brief.text: Design an open-air tea pavilion with an asymmetric timber roof that curls upward at one end. Include supporting beams, benches, a stone plinth and a restrained tea setting, using curved geometry and a warm timber, ivory and charcoal palette.

revisions.title: Initial design
revisions.description: First retained pavilion with its curved canopy, timber structure and tea setting.

revisions.title: Roof and framing revision
revisions.description: Adjusted the roof curl, increased the rib lattice and moved a column and water spout.

revisions.title: Previous gallery revision
revisions.description: Added column collars, tea-setting and garden details, and increased the canopy surface resolution.

revisions.title: Flush faces fixed
revisions.description: Maintainer revision by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code (2026-11-12): 1 part edit that separates faces lying on one plane, which flickered in any renderer. Materials, names, hierarchy and animation are unchanged.
